Swedish Meatballs

1 lb grnd beef
1/2 lb grnd pork
1/2 c panko bread crums
1/3 c milk (whole)
1 EGG
1/2 sm onion grated
1/4 tsp alspice
pinch nutmeg
S&P

3 tbs butter
3 tbs flour
2 c beef broth or water + better than bouillon
1/2 c sour cream
1 tbs worchestershire
1 tsp dijon
fresh parsely chopped

mix meatball stuff, roll into balls (about 1"), brown in batches. make gravy in same pan, add meatballs back and simmer 10ish. serve over egg noodles or mashed potatoes
